clips.knockdown: knees buckle, it topples onto its side and lies there (the capture hold)

clips.feed: head down to a carcass, tearing bites with a tug

tactics._about: # ASSUMPTION (SP-CERATOSAURUS, owner: 'Be creative with what moves you think they should do when they fight'). A lone mid-size hunter on the saber_cat profile, without the stalk or the pin. Near a river or the shore it lurks on the bank and opens with a crocodile-like LUNGE out of the water's edge (the ambush pounce: a low surge, jaws first) at prey inside ambush_radius_m, or a back turned inside back_radius_m; away from water it hunts in the open. From 5-11 m: the lunge (pounce, telegraphed by the gore crouch under the ground ring), a roar into a charge, or a sidestep into the lunge. Point blank: a TAIL SWIPE when the prey is behind it (kick), the NOSE-HORN GORE (heavy: a held head-down crouch and horn wag, then an upward jab-and-hook), or the SLASHING BITE (bite) that makes the prey bleed.
